usage: One catty is roughly equal to 600 grams and is a commonly used unit of weight in Hong Kong markets.
Using catties to buy vegetables is convenient and helps estimate portions.
“One catty” is not a standard metric unit and is more commonly used in Chinese markets.
When buying produce, shop staff will tell you how many catties and taels it weighs to calculate the price.
A catty can be used to describe the weight of meat, fruit, or vegetables.
